power.input-feeds: one inlet for all eight outlets

base.description: The unit as the hardware guide's figures 2.3 and 2.4 show it, with NEMA 5-15R outlets. The 15 Amp power cable is in the box (specification table); the photograph shows rack brackets on the unit, and no held document lists them. The -2 and -3 models of the same housing have IEC C13 outlets and are not modelled here.

description: WTI NPS-8HS20-1 network power switch (switched PDU), 1U. The front carries an RJ45 set-up port, ON and RDY lamps, DEFAULT and RESET buttons, eight output status lamps and two 20 A circuit breakers. The rear carries one IEC C20 inlet, eight switched NEMA 5-15R outlets, A1 to A8, two alarm lamps and a 10/100/1000 Ethernet jack.

gaps.note: The top is drawn the front's #414043, the same black finish as the front. The specification sheet's photograph reads the top plane at #a8a8a6 because it is lit from above; that is the lighting and not a separate finish. The underside and the two sides are drawn the same colour: no patch of the photograph was read for them, as it shows the top and one side at an angle only. No straight-on photograph of the top under neutral light is held.
gaps.wanted: A photograph of the top and the sides under neutral light.

gaps.note: Only one angled photograph of the NPS-8HS20-1 is held, 860 pixels wide for both faces. Every position is read from the guide's line art, and no face has been laid over a straight-on photograph.
gaps.wanted: A straight-on photograph of each face.

gaps.note: The guide names the lamps and states no colour or state for them; they are drawn as plain discs.
gaps.wanted: The maker's lamp table for the front and rear panels.

gaps.note: The ears are not dimensioned and no held document says whether they are inside the 19 in width. The photograph shows three slots in each bracket.
gaps.wanted: A dimensioned drawing of the rack bracket and of the body.

gaps.note: The figure draws each breaker as a box and a rocker with no size and no part number. They are drawn at the figure's scale.
gaps.wanted: The breaker's part number and outline.

gaps.note: The guide says each inlet has a cable keeper, pre-installed on the NPS-8HS (section 4); the figure does not draw it and the photograph shows a wire clip on the inlet. It is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: The maker's drawing of the keeper.

gaps.note: The Ethernet jack part draws its two lamp windows at the jack's lower corners. Figure 2.4 and the photograph put them at the upper corners, under the ACT and LINK captions. Moving them needs a new version of the shared jack part, which this change does not make.
gaps.wanted: A version of the jack part with its lamp windows at the upper corners.

gaps.note: Figure 2.4 draws the inlet with a frame and two hexagon holes beside the housing. Only the library's inlet housing is drawn.
gaps.wanted: The maker's dimensioned drawing of the inlet area.

gaps.note: The underside and the two sides are drawn as plain outlines at the stated size (482.6 by 220.98 mm and 220.98 by 44.45 mm); no held document draws or names them. The photograph shows the top cover and, at an angle, one side with a row of slots along its top edge, too small to place a slot.
gaps.wanted: A drawing or a straight-on photograph that names each side.

eth.description: the 10/100/1000 Ethernet network port on the rear

inlets.description: the one IEC C20 inlet, at the left of the rear as seen from behind

outlets.description: the eight switched NEMA 5-15R outlets, A1 to A8, all from the one inlet

setup.description: the RJ45 RS232 SetUp port on the front

name: nps-8hs20-1

breakers.note: Hardware guide section 2.3, item 7: two circuit breakers, one for outlets A1 to A4 and one for A5 to A8, each 20 Amp on the NPS-8HS20-1 (also the specification table). Figure 2.3 draws each as a square box with a rocker, captioned 'A1 - A4' and 'A5 - A8'. The photograph shows black rockers with a red mark. They are drawn as art, as the library holds no breaker part for this kind.

chassis.note: Width 19 in (482.6 mm), depth 8.7 in (220.98 mm) and height 1.75 in (44.45 mm), 1 U, from the specification table. The table's width is the figure's whole faceplate, and no document held says whether the rack ears are inside it or whether the body is narrower. The face is drawn the full 482.6 mm wide. No net weight is stated, only a shipping weight of 11 lb in the table's NPS-8HX20-X row, so none is given.

colour.note: Each colour is the median of a flat patch of the specification sheet's photograph of the NPS-8HS20-1 (the patch sizes are not recorded): the front face #414043, the rear plate #ffffff with black printing, the buttons #fafafa and the top cover, lit from above, #a8a8a6. The top is the same black finish as the front seen in brighter light (the enclosure is one painted box with no seam and no separate cover), so it is drawn the front's #414043 and the lit reading is declared in the colour gap. The red rule is drawn in #ed1c24, an estimate: no patch of the photograph or the figure was read for it; the logo is not drawn. The photograph is 860 pixels wide for the two faces and the sides are seen at an angle, so a colour is read only from a flat patch of a face.

ears.note: The photograph on the specification sheet shows a bracket at each end of the front, with three slots; it is the only source for the ears, and nothing about them is measured. The specification table gives the 19 in width and says nothing of brackets. The ear hole pitch and the ear setback are not stated by any held document. The ears are taken as flush with the faceplate, as photographed.

ethernet.note: One RJ45 network port on the rear, 10/100/1000Base-T (hardware guide, section 2.4, item 4; specification table 'Ethernet Port: 10/100/1000 BaseT'), with a link and an activity lamp that belong to the jack part. The part draws the two lamp windows at the jack's lower corners and the figure puts them at the upper corners (gap ethernet-lamp-windows).

inlets.note: One IEC 60320 C20 inlet (hardware guide, section 2.4, 'NPS-8HS20-1 Units: One IEC 60320 C20 inlet, for 100/120V power'). The table prints the voltage range 85/125V. The power cord is detachable and the table says the -1 model 'Includes 15 Amp Power Cable'; no cord is drawn, as the table is not a drawing of one. The guide says the NPS-8HS inlet carries a pre-installed cable keeper (section 4); it is not drawn.

lamps.note: The lamps are drawn as plain discs, not as states: the guide names them (ON, RDY, output status, alarm) and states no colour for any. The photograph shows the front lamps lit green and yellow; one lit photograph is not a table of colours, so none is claimed.

method.note: THE FIGURES CARRY NO CONNECTOR DIMENSION. Each position is the centre of a drawn outline (a jack's frame, an outlet's box, an inlet's housing, a lamp's disc), converted at one scale on both axes: the figure's drawn outline width taken as the table's 19 in, 482.6 mm (1.5118 mm per point on the front figure, 1.5133 on the back). Heights are measured from the figure's vertical centre and set about the face's centre, because the drawn outline is taller than 19 to 1.75 in proportion (about 5 to 13 percent, depending on whether the stroke is counted), so the figure is not at true proportion. The scale is checked against two library parts: the figure's outlet box is 18.25 points wide, 27.6 mm here, against 27.0 for `std/nema-5-15r`, and its inlet housing is 21.08 points wide, 31.9 mm here, against 32.4 for `std/c20-inlet`. Every position is good to about 1.5 mm. The captions are placed from the figure's glyph positions and sized from its cap heights, to about 0.7 mm. The breakers are drawn from the figure's two boxes (the guide gives no size for a breaker) as plain art, not as a part.

outlets.note: Hardware guide section 2.4 and figure 2.4: eight switched NEMA 5-15R outlets in one row, A1 to A8, all fed by the one inlet. The specification table says the same for the -1 model, with a (1) 20 Amp input feed and two 20 Amp circuit breakers.

power.note: Specification table: AC voltage 85/125V, 50/60 Hz, power distribution '1.3/2 kW' with the footnote '80% Derated', one 20 Amp input feed. The unit's own draw is not stated by any held document, so no power-max-w is given.

setup-port.note: An RJ45 RS232 serial port, DCE configuration (hardware guide, section 2.3, item 1; appendix B), on the front at the left. The specification table gives 'RJ45, RS232C'. The pinout is the guide's appendix B and is not stated on the jack. The jack is drawn latch notch down, as the photograph shows it.

sources.note: Every position on both faces is read from the vector figures of the NPS Series Hardware Guide (part 14531 rev A): figure 2.3, the NPS-8HS front panel (PDF page 9), and figure 2.4, the NPS-8HS back panel (PDF page 10). The figures are line art with no dimension printed on them. The size is from the NPS specification table (PDF page 2 of the specification sheet): W 19 in (48.3 cm), D 8.7 in (22 cm), H 1.75 in (4.5 cm), 1 U, the row shared by the NPS-8HS, 8HD and 8H20-ATS models. The colours are read from the product photograph of the NPS-8HS20-1 on page 1 of the specification sheet (an angled photograph, front above and back below, 860 by 283 pixels). The guide draws NEMA 5-15R outlets in figure 2.4 and its text says the NPS-8HS20-1 has them, so this model is the one the figures draw. The hardware guide's -2 and -3 models have IEC C13 outlets, which no figure draws.
